value.syntax: # [doc = " Outcome of running the wrapped command."] # [derive (Debug , Clone)] pub struct ExecOutcome { # [doc = " Numeric exit code. Signal terminations are reported as `128 + signal`."] pub exit_code : i32 , # [doc = " True when captured output may be incomplete: a log-file write,"] # [doc = " a child-stream read, or a writer finalization failed.
